terms.title: Terms of Service
terms.description: These terms explain the rules for using the official waoowaoo cloud service. This is a payment-review draft and the legal entity details will be replaced after you provide verified company information.
terms.updatedAt: Last updated: to be confirmed before production launch

merchant.title: Merchant entity
merchant.body: The service is expected to be operated by a Hong Kong registered company. The legal English company name, registration number, registered address, support phone, and support email are currently placeholders and must be replaced before applying to Stripe or Airwallex.

service.title: Service description
service.body: waoowaoo provides an AI-assisted workspace for film, story, shot planning, image, video, and music generation. Users can create projects, upload assets, generate content, and manage creative assets.

credits.title: Credits
credits.body: The official cloud edition uses credits or points for AI generation. Credits can only be used inside the platform, are not cash, are not an e-wallet or stored-value account, cannot be withdrawn, and cannot be transferred or redeemed outside the platform.

acceptableUse.title: Prohibited use
acceptableUse.body: Users must not use the service to create or distribute illegal, adult sexual, gambling, hateful, extremist, fraudulent, phishing, infringing, impersonation, child-sensitive, or otherwise unlawful content, or content that violates payment provider rules or platform policies.

content.title: User content and generated output
content.body: Users are responsible for ensuring they have the necessary rights to uploaded assets, prompts, and intended uses. AI output may be inaccurate or similar to existing content, and users should review it before publication, commercial use, or distribution.

account.title: Accounts
account.body: Users must keep account credentials secure. The platform may restrict, suspend, or terminate accounts involved in abnormal activity, violations, fraud, abuse, or actions that affect service security or stability.

payments.title: Payments and credits
payments.body: The official cloud edition supports self-service credit purchases through Stripe. Users enter a top-up amount in the account billing page and are redirected to Stripe-hosted Checkout. Currently available methods include Stripe-enabled cards, Link, Apple Pay, and other approved methods; local payment methods such as WeChat Pay and Alipay depend on payment-provider approval. Manual admin grants are used only for trials, tests, or operational credits.

liability.title: Limitation of liability
liability.body: To the extent permitted by applicable law, the platform is not liable for indirect losses, lost profits, data loss, third-party service interruptions, AI output errors, or losses caused by user misuse beyond what the law requires.

law.title: Governing law
law.body: The governing law and jurisdiction will depend on the company's registration location and final legal review. The current placeholder assumes Hong Kong law and must be confirmed before launch.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: This policy explains how we collect, use, and protect data when providing AI creative services. This is a payment-review draft.
privacy.updatedAt: Last updated: to be confirmed before production launch

controller.title: Data controller
controller.body: The service is expected to be operated by a Hong Kong registered company. The final company name, registered address, and contact email will be added after you provide verified details.

dataCollected.title: Data we collect
dataCollected.body: We may collect account information, login records, project content, uploaded assets, prompts, generated outputs, task logs, credit ledger records, payment records, and support communications.

userContent.title: Uploaded and generated content
userContent.body: To provide generation services, we process user-uploaded text, images, videos, audio, and project data. User content may be sent to necessary third-party AI providers to complete generation tasks.

providers.title: Third-party providers
providers.body: We may use AI model providers, payment processors, object storage, databases, logging, email, and infrastructure providers. The final provider list will be updated before production launch.

payments.title: Payment data
payments.body: Sensitive payment details such as card numbers are handled by Stripe, Airwallex, or other payment providers. We generally store only orders, credits, transaction statuses, and required accounting records.

retention.title: Retention
retention.body: We retain data for as long as needed to provide the service, perform contracts, handle disputes, comply with law, and support security audits. Specific retention periods will be confirmed before launch.

rights.title: User rights
rights.body: Users may contact support to request access, correction, export, or deletion of account data. Some data may be retained for accounting, compliance, security, or dispute-resolution purposes.

security.title: Security
security.body: We use access controls, key management, encryption, audit logs, and infrastructure security measures to protect data, but no internet service can guarantee absolute security.

contact.title: Privacy contact
contact.body: Privacy requests should be sent to the official support email. The current email is a placeholder and must be replaced before production launch.

refund.title: Refund Policy
refund.description: This policy explains refund rules for trial credits and paid credits.
refund.updatedAt: Last updated: to be confirmed before production launch

beta.title: Beta credits
beta.body: Credits issued through manual admin grants are not purchased cash rights and are not eligible for cash refunds, withdrawals, or transfer.

paidCredits.title: Paid credits
paidCredits.body: Unused paid credits may be refundable within the specified refund window after purchase. The current refund window is 7 days after purchase; used packages, consumed credits, or credits already used for generation tasks that incurred service costs are not refundable.

usedCredits.title: Used credits
usedCredits.body: Credits used for AI generation tasks, successfully settled after freezing, or already incurring third-party model costs are generally non-refundable. Failed tasks are rolled back or returned according to system rules.

abuse.title: Abuse and fraud
abuse.body: Refunds are not guaranteed for accounts restricted due to violations, abuse, fraud, fraudulent payment disputes, content policy violations, or unlawful activity.

process.title: Refund process
process.body: Users should submit refund requests through the support email with the account, order number, and reason. Eligible refunds will generally be returned to the original payment method, subject to payment provider and card issuer timelines.

chargebacks.title: Disputes
chargebacks.body: Users should contact support first if they have questions about a transaction. Direct chargebacks or payment disputes may temporarily restrict the account while the investigation is completed.
